dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why's there someone passed out here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heeey! Can you hear Paimon? Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You help the man up, and he slowly regains consciousness...

choices.text: Hello. Have you had too much to drink?

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: Head hurts... How'd I... Lemme think...

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: Ah! I remember! I think I got knocked out by someone... but I didn't see who. Wait... It wasn't you, was it!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! We're the ones who helped you up! You should be thanking us!

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: Oh, sorry... Uhm, I work at the Me & Dew bar. I was originally going to deliver some goods to the port in the north... A merchants' association from Nod-Krai bought some Aphimead from us, you see.

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: Oh! No! The Aphimead! It's gone! Did they steal it? Wait, YOU didn't steal it, did you!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why do you keep accusing us!?

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: Oh, right. Sorry, sorry... I guess it must be the dizziness. Thanks, you two. I need to head back to the bar and tell them what happened...

response.speaker: Unconscious Employee
response.text: If there really are bandits on the loose, you should probably stay away from the northern port. It could be dangerous.

choices.text: Do you need me to take you home?
